description:
Continue (extend) a video previously generated by Kling, adding roughly 4-5 seconds per extension.

WORKFLOW:
1. You need the video_id of a Kling-generated video (from check_kling_task or list_kling_tasks, valid for 30 days after generation)
2. Call this tool → returns a new task_id
3. Wait 30 seconds, then call check_kling_task(task_id, task_type="video-extend")
4. Repeat until status is "succeed". Each extension adds ~4-5s; chain calls for longer videos.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL that Kling POSTs the task result to when the task status changes. Optional — polling with check_kling_task works without it.

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the extension: "blurry, distorted faces, watermark"

prompt.description: How the video should continue: next action, camera movement. Max 2500 chars.

video_id.description: ID of a video generated by Kling (the video.id from a completed task result, NOT the task_id). Must have been generated within the last 30 days.

name: extend_kling_video
